In either case, following the conditional chain: (1) if Ada wears an ivory hat → Ada wears a scarlet ribbon (p18), and (2) if Ada wears an ivory badge → Ada wears a scarlet ribbon (p6). In both cases, Ada wears a scarlet ribbon. Then from p4: if Ada wears a scarlet ribbon → Ada wears an ivory coat. Therefore, Ada wears an ivory coat necessarily follows from the premises.
